why: What Thornswood-Last.esp leaves alone, and the mod quests it stops as well. Patrick, 12 Oct 2026: every vanilla quest can be cut. His answers the same evening to the eight decisions on issue 2468 were 'all recommended': the barter, carriage, follower, courier and start-up quests are stopped with the rest, the creature voices and the authored corpses stay, and the sixteen mod quests with gate, door or arrival talk are stopped too.

corpses.why: The 1,361 authored corpses (startsDead) are cut from the living population, but they never flashed: the client's world cleaner leaves a dead placed actor where it lies, so they stand as scenery. Patrick, 12 Oct 2026: keep them as scenery (decision 7 on issue 2468).
